Draw one entirely NEW complete full-body FRONT Japanese anime character design on clean white portrait background, head to shoe soles fully visible. It fills only the central slightly-more-than-half of the usable width, about55–60% of the distance between side stitching lines, never a large logo filling the panel. The key appearance is a LARGE uninterrupted ORANGE border on all four sides of the small print, matching image4's generous logo-to-net-pocket spacing. Do not count sleeve outside the bag as margin.
